title: Failure as Progress: Balancing Permanent Growth and Anti-Farm Mechanics
subtitle: A deep dive into Roguelike permanent growth scaling and anti-farming systems. Learn how to balance rhythm-based unlocks and numerical feedback to transform player frustration into a compelling progression loop, ensuring a fair and engaging strategy space.

breakdown.title: Setting the Permanent Growth Rate
bullets: Too high growth leads to trivial runs; too low makes failure meaningless.
Best practice: Split growth into three tracks: numerical stats, functional unlocks, and content unlocks.
Recommendation: Keep permanent numerical stats at 20~35% of total power, relying on gameplay mastery and build composition for the rest.

breakdown.title: Preventing Farming Failures
bullets: Tie rewards to performance metrics: survival time, kills, depth, and task completion.
Implement diminishing returns for early exits: minimal or no rewards for quitting within the first 2 minutes.
Set daily or per-run caps with milestone bonuses to encourage players to push deeper.

breakdown.title: Turning Frustration into Purpose
bullets: Clear failure summaries tell players exactly what progress was made.
Introduce small variations for the next run (new talent/weapon/event) to maintain interest.
Make near-misses explainable (e.g., one key away, one layer short) to provide a clear next step.
